title: fanoutqa: Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held? (ca2bf128869985f6)

chat_history.content: Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held?

content.content:
The user asks: "Where are the six marathon races in the world marathon majors hosted, and when was each first held?" They want location (city/country) and first held year for each of the six World Marathon Majors.

World Marathon Majors: Tokyo, Boston, London, Berlin, Chicago, New York City.

Need to provide location (city and country) and the year each marathon was first held. Possibly also include dates? But they ask "when was each first held?" So year.

We can answer directly. Need confirm first year of each marathon.

Boston Marathon: first held in 1897 (April 19, 1897), location: Boston, Massachusetts, USA (actually starts in Hopkinton and finishes in Boston). Could note.

London Marathon: first held in 1981 (29 March 1981), location: London, England, United Kingdom.

Berlin Marathon: first held in 1974 (13 September 1974), location: Berlin, Germany.

Chicago Marathon: first held in 1977 (October 1977), location: Chicago, Illinois, USA.

New York City Marathon: first held in 1970 (September 13, 1970), location: New York City, New York, USA.

Tokyo Marathon: first held in 2007 (18 March 2007) for the current event (Tokyo Marathon). However there were earlier Tokyo International Marathon (1981-2006) and Tokyo Women's Marathon (1979-2008). But the World Marathon Major inclusion started with the Tokyo Marathon in 2007. So answer: Tokyo Marathon, Tokyo, Japan, first held 2007.

Thus list.

Provide maybe a table.

Also could note that Tokyo Marathon is held in Tokyo, Japan, first held 2007.

Will answer succinctly.

content:
**World Marathon Majors – Host Cities & Inaugural Years**

| Marathon (World Marathon Major) | Host City & Country | Year of First Edition |
|--------------------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|
| **Boston Marathon** | Boston (finishes in Boston), Massachusetts, United States | **1897** – April 19, 1897 |
| **London Marathon** | London, England, United Kingdom | **1981** – 29 March 1981 |
| **Berlin Marathon** | Berlin, Germany | **1974** – 13 September 1974 |
| **Chicago Marathon** | Chicago, Illinois, United States | **1977** – October 1977 |
| **New York City Marathon** | New York City, New York, United States | **1970** – 13 September 1970 |
| **Tokyo Marathon** | Tokyo, Japan | **2007** – 18 March 2007* |

\*The Tokyo Marathon (the event that became part of the World Marathon Majors) was first held in 2007. Earlier Tokyo‑based marathons existed (Tokyo International Marathon, Tokyo Women’s Marathon), but the current Tokyo Marathon is the one counted among the Majors.
